title: Can Personal Requirements Become Supervision for Planning?
abstract: arXiv:2610.40992v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Managing multiple chronic conditions through diet requires satisfying disease- and medication-specific requirements jointly across meals and days while preserving established eating habits. These requirements are public in clinical guidelines and drug labels, yet turning them into a feasible plan for one person remains difficult for language-model agents. In our dietitian-approved weekly planning evaluation built from NHANES, thirteen models, from medically fine-tuned 8B models to GPT-6.1 Sol, pass fewer than 3% of complete plans through direct generation. Explicit rules, higher reasoning effort, or model-directed tools leave GPT-6.1 Sol at no more than 8%. We present Noura, which pairs LLM planning with executable personal specifications instantiated from public clinical guidance and individual health and dietary profiles. translated_title: 个人需求能否成为规划任务的监督？
translated_abstract: 通过饮食管理多种慢性疾病，需要同时满足跨餐次和跨天数的疾病与用药特定要求，同时保持已有的饮食习惯。这些要求在临床指南和药品说明书中是公开的，然而语言模型智能体仍难以将它们转化为适用于个体的可行方案。在我们基于NHANES构建的、经营养师审核的每周饮食规划评估中，十三个模型——从经过医学微调的8B模型到GPT-6.1 Sol——通过直接生成的完整方案通过率不足3%；即使采用显式规则、更高的推理投入或模型主导的工具，GPT-6.1 Sol的通过率也不超过8%。我们提出了Noura，它将大语言模型规划与可执行的个人规范相结合，这些规范由公开的临床指南以及个人健康与饮食档案实例化而来。在规划过程中，该规范为食物选择提供依据、优化份量、检查完整的多日方案，并指导……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Noura框架，将公开临床指南与个人健康饮食档案实例化为可执行的个人规范，以此监督大语言模型的膳食规划，解决了直接生成完整多日慢性病饮食方案通过率不足3%的难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Noura, which instantiates public clinical guidance and individual health/dietary profiles into executable personal specifications that supervise LLM planning, tackling the failure of direct generation (under 3% pass rate) to produce complete multi-day diet plans for managing multiple chronic conditions.
